# Retained Librarian reading helpers

Copied unchanged from owned Librarian source `53ffd4cf3781e7f11ee9f63a68b279e7c8dd0782`, `src/reading.js` and its `catalog-rights.js` import. Local Hole library uses actual page clamping/text pagination and PDF validation. Public catalogs, downloads, account collections and provider features remain in the original Librarian route; these helpers do not grant those capabilities or licenses. PDF rendering uses Hole's already-vendored PDF.js engine.
